description:
The drawing is titled "Diagram 2.17 Wall type 2.3" in a green header band, and is identified by the word "SECTION" in the lower right corner, indicating it is a vertical cut through a wall rather than a plan.

It shows two parallel, upright wall elements set side by side with a narrow vertical gap between them. Each element is drawn as a column of four stacked rectangular blocks separated by horizontal lines, and every block is filled with a cross-hatch (diagonal X) pattern. A full-height vertical line runs along the outer face of each element, just outside the edge of the hatched rectangle, so that the outer face is shown by two close parallel vertical lines, while the inner (cavity) face is shown by a single vertical line (the edge of the hatched rectangle).

At the middle horizontal dividing line, a short horizontal member spans the gap, joining the two elements, and a small vertical tick is placed at the centre of this connector. No dimensions, scale bar or further labels are present.
